nodes.name: Send Lead Events to Meta CAPI

parameters.content:
## WA Hot Lead Scorer
1. WAHA message.any -> /webhook/wa-hotlead
2. Verify HMAC (WAHA_HMAC_SECRET env, SHA512)
3. Normalize payload.* + dedupe by payload.id
4. Rebuild last 20 messages per sender (Cust:/Biz:)
5. Indonesian rule scoring (warm>=20, hot>=60)
6. Is Hot? -> true: Notify Sales + [disabled] Meta; false: Log Warm/Cold

Bahasa rules: scoring/indonesian-rules.json
LLM fallback: scoring/llm-classify-prompt.md
7. Export Lead to Sheet (OAuth): every scored lead -> Google Sheet 'Leads'

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ data: [ { event_name: 'Purchase', event_time: Math.floor(Date.now()/1000), event_id: 'purchase_' + $json.message_id, action_source: 'system_generated', user_data: { ph: [$json.phone_hash_sha256] }, custom_data: { currency: 'IDR', value: $json.purchase_value || 0 } } ] }) }}
